name: Luft Weizen
original_name: ルフト・ヴァイツェン
source:
Luft Weizen was a general in the Transbaal Empire Armed Forces, as well as Tact Mayers's old teacher. He not only rescued Takuto, but gave him command of both the Elle Ciel and Angel Troupe.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Luft_Weizen]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]

[spoiler]At the end of the Galaxy Angel story he became Minister of Defence and Prime minister of Transbaal Empire[/spoiler]
